title: Instance templates and managed instance groups

videos.script: Three machines that should be the same drift apart. This lesson is about keeping them the same. {{template}} An instance template describes a machine once. It can never be edited. A change is a new template, and Terraform has two lines that make that work. {{group}} A managed group keeps a number of machines alive from that template. Delete one by hand, and the group makes another. You stop managing machines and start managing a number. {{health}} A health check asks each machine a question. A machine that fails it is replaced. The delay before the first question matters more than anything else in the block. {{rolling}} Last, the rolling update. Surge adds machines before removing any. A canary sends one machine ahead, so a mistake breaks one machine instead of three.
